paragraphs.text: You sense, rather than see, stars descend from the sky above you. From your flaming tether, you reach out to command the stars.
Every magic point you committed gives you a 10% chance to succeed. So if you committed 6 magic points, you must make a 60% roll. Any roll of 96-00 is always a fail.
If you succeed with Command Ye Celestial Flames, go to 209. If you fail, go to 65.
